notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Allies.
description:
Activate Harabaz Druid by tapping it, adding at least {2}.
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, targeting Harabaz Druid.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Aphetto Alchemist's ability, targeting Aphetto Alchemist.
Resolve both Aphetto Alchemist abilities, untapping it and Harabaz Druid.
Repeat.
